app.title: Bookmark Manager
search.tier.title: Title matches
organize.err.needCategory: At least one folder is required
organize.intro: Clusters bookmarks by meaning and lets the AI name the folders, up to 3 levels deep.
organize.connectivity.hint: Checks for dead links (404/410) and moves them into [待删除_失效]. Those are skipped when organizing.
organize.connectivity.done: Done: {count} dead links moved to [待删除_失效]
organize.title: Organize Bookmarks
organize.category.hint: Top-level folders from your bookmarks. Add or remove as you like; the AI prefers reusing these names when naming.
organize.category.fitNote: You chose "Fit into existing folders" - the real structure comes from your bookmarks. This list only hints the AI when naming.
organize.allowMoveOut: Let bookmarks move out of this folder
organize.allowMoveOutHint: Uses the whole bookmark bar as reference; bookmarks that match another folder better will move there.
organize.keepInsideHint: Subdivides inside this folder only; bookmarks never leave it.
organize.moveOutOverridesReplan: With a move-out target checked, "Re-plan the folder structure" no longer applies: re-planning creates new subfolders inside, and those always match, so nothing would ever move out.
organize.moveOutTargets: Bookmarks may move out to these folders (only checked ones; none checked = never leaves):
organize.moveOutNoTargets: No other folders under the bookmark bar - there is nowhere to move out to.
organize.domainStep.hint: These are all bookmark domains. Check the ones you want as standalone directories — the domain's portal page (root/index) is included automatically. Unchecked bookmarks continue to AI classification.
organize.domainStep.inFolderHint: All bookmarks of this domain already sit in the matching folder. Selecting it usually changes nothing - you can skip it.
organize.preview.renameHint: Folder names are editable - click one to change it. Renaming to an existing folder name merges the two.
organize.stats.warnThreshold: Most bookmarks did not match any directory closely enough, so nearest-neighbour assignment was used. Lower the assign threshold and retry for a stricter split.
organize.stats.warnVector: Vector dimension mismatch detected (stale model vectors in the index); the similarity threshold was skipped.
organize.stats.warnAi: AI unavailable - directory names came from keywords. Configure a model for more fitting names.
organize.stats.warnAiFailed: A model is configured but the call failed - directory names came from keywords. Check the network and key, then retry.
organize.overflowDir: Created from bookmarks that matched no existing directory
dedup.title: Deduplication
dedup.confirm: This will scan for duplicate bookmarks. Continue?
settings.title: Settings
settings.ai.title: AI Configuration
settings.ai.fillFirst: Fill in the endpoint and model before testing
settings.semantic.title: Semantic Services
settings.semantic.hint: Semantic search and organizing depend on these two services. Run Text Embeddings Inference with bge-m3 and bge-reranker, or any compatible server. Leave blank to use the local defaults.
settings.search.title: Search Configuration
settings.organize.title: Organization
settings.organize.maxDepthHint: Max nesting depth for AI-generated directories (1-3 levels)
settings.dedup.title: Deduplication
settings.index.title: Index Management
organize.connectivity.result: {dead} dead links found and moved to [待删除_失效]
dedup.manual.hint: Select bookmarks then click Force Dedup to keep the best one
dedup.fine.hint: Select bookmarks to compare (≥2). AI will fetch summaries and detect content overlap.
dedup.fine.noAi: No AI configured. Summaries are shown for manual review.
dedup.fine.aiHint: AI has analyzed content similarity. Review deletion suggestions below.
organize.scope.title: Select Organize Scope
organize.scope.hint: Organizing can be run repeatedly: correctly filed bookmarks stay put, misfiled ones get corrected.
organize.stats.warnNothingToDo: The existing structure already matches: no bookmark needs to move. If everything sits in one folder, switch to "Re-plan the folder structure".
organize.mode.title: Organize Mode
organize.mode.fitHint: Use the current folder structure as the skeleton. Correctly filed bookmarks are left alone, misfiled ones move to a better folder, and only bookmarks that match nothing get a new folder. Safe to re-run.
organize.mode.replanHint: Ignore the existing structure and re-cluster from scratch. Folders change substantially - use when starting over.
organize.scope.globalHint: Organize all bookmarks, including already-filed ones.
organize.domainStep.portalBadgeHint: This domain has a root or index page; when checked, that page is filed together with the rest of the domain.
organize.undo.done: Restored: {restored} bookmarks moved back, {inPlace} already in place, {recreated} folders recreated, {removed} created folders removed
organize.undo.hint: Restores the bookmark structure to before this organize run. Only the most recent run is kept; the record is cleared after undoing.
organize.preview.failures: These bookmarks could not be moved:
organize.undo.retry: {failed} item(s) could not be restored. The undo record is kept — click again to retry.
organize.category.taxonomyHint: These are the top-level categories consolidated from your existing folders. Edit as you like — organize may only use these names at the top level.
manage.title: Bookmark manager
manage.move.title: Move bookmarks
manage.merge.title: Merge folders
manage.move.hint: Pick a folder, tick the bookmarks, then choose the destination.
manage.move.empty: No bookmarks directly in this folder (subfolders excluded)
manage.merge.hint: Tick the folders to merge; their contents move into the target, then the sources are removed.
manage.confirmMerge: Merge? Source folders will be deleted; their bookmarks and subfolders move into the target.
organize.manual.title: Manual fixes
organize.manual.hint: Adjust anything the AI got wrong.
organize.idle.note: Safe to re-run · correctly filed bookmarks stay put
